scripts.premarp:dev: find -L slides/images -type f \( -iname '*.jpg' -o -iname '*.jpeg' \) -exec sh -c 'umask 022; for f; do t=$(readlink -f "$f"); jpegtran -copy none -optimize -outfile "${t}.tmp" "$t" || { rm -f "${t}.tmp"; exit 1; }; chmod --reference="$t" "${t}.tmp" || { rm -f "${t}.tmp"; exit 1; }; mv "${t}.tmp" "$t" || { rm -f "${t}.tmp"; exit 1; }; done' _ {} +
